in_arabic.name: Miskah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Miskah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Islamic tradition, the name Miskah is derived from the Arabic word ‘misk’ which means ‘honey’. The name signifies a person who is sweet and nurturing, just like honey. In the Quran, honey is mentioned as a blessing from Allah and a cure for the believers. Therefore, Miskah is a name full of spiritual and emotional significance in Islam.
